failedAssertions.reason: No warning is shown when the user starts validation with proxy enabled but no proxies configured. Browser automation confirmed: enabled proxy toggle in Settings > Proxy tab (localStorage: enabled:true, proxies:[]), navigated to validation view, entered test email, clicked Start Validation — validation proceeded to dashboard without any toast, dialog, or banner. Code in handleStartValidation (App.tsx:62) and startValidation (use-email-validation.ts:167) has no guard for this condition.
failedAssertions.suggestedFix: Add a check in handleStartValidation (App.tsx) that reads proxy settings from localStorage (or useSettings hook), checks if proxy.enabled === true && proxy.proxies.length === 0, and if so, calls showWarning('No proxies configured. Add proxies in Settings or disable proxy to continue.') from lib/toast.ts and returns early without starting validation.
